source: Scouting and fog of war (see the GDD, 'Scouting and fog of war'). Knowledge of a subject (0 to 100) is the sum of five parts, capped at 'cap': scouts ('scouts.max' shared out by 1 minus the product of what each scout leaves unknown; a scout counts at 'assigned', 'kind' or 'other' of their skill, and a Head of Scouting lifts every scout's skill by a share set in the executive data (up to 25%)), evidence ('perFinal' for each scored final in the last 'seasons' seasons, up to 'max'), visibility ('visibility' times fame), standing (prestige and fame of the player's garage) and experience. An attention flag adds 'attentionFlag'. Below 'rangeFrom' only a word is shown; from 'rangeFrom' a range of whole numbers whose half-width falls from 'widest' to 'narrowest'; from 'exactFrom' the exact value. Potential reads 'potentialPenalty' lower. 'bands' name a value: a word for each, up to its 'max'. 'staff' sets what a scout costs: a year's wage of 'wageBase' plus 'wagePerSkill' for each point of skill, paid in 'roundsPerSeason' parts, 'candidates' on offer at a time and at most 'maxPerGarage' employed; a scout on offer is aged within 'age' and retires at 'retireAge' (checked when the season starts). 'inspection' is what a paid inspection of a car for sale costs: 'fee' takes that car to exact while the seller still owns it. 'tips' sets what a Head of Scouting hears first: up to 'max' drivers aged 'maxAge' or younger, not the garage's own, whose potential reads 'minPotential' or more (by the midpoint of the reading the player has, never the truth).
